hypotheses.R0_same_feature_task_subspaces_recur: At rank 64, same-feature donor task subspaces capture at least 1.25 times as much target response energy as different-feature donor subspaces in every sampled block.
hypotheses.R1_recurrence_is_not_only_state_spectrum: The same/different feature ratio for task-selected response subspaces exceeds the ratio for top-spectral response subspaces in at least six of eight blocks.
hypotheses.R2_output_role_recurrence: At rank 64, same-feature donor task U subspaces capture at least 1.25 times as much target incoming-adjoint energy as different-feature donor subspaces in every sampled block.
hypotheses.R3_recurrence_survives_position_control: At rank 64, same-feature response-subspace projection exceeds nearest-position different-feature projection in at least six of eight blocks.
hypotheses.R4_feature_labels_beat_permutation: At rank 64, task-selected response recurrence has a one-sided feature-label permutation p-value at most 0.05 in at least six of eight blocks.
